description: Compare a company's core financial metrics across two fiscal periods side-by-side. Shows absolute and percentage changes with significance classification (minor < 5%, notable 5–15%, significant > 15%). Each row's `derived_id` cites the percentage change (`delta_pct_display`) and `delta_derived_id` cites the absolute change (`delta_display`): cite the id of the figure you quote. The response includes a `material_changes` count: this is the number of metrics whose `significance` ∈ {notable, significant} (i.e. absolute percentage change > 5%).  Use it as a quick scalar to triage filings — anything > ~3 typically signals a material event worth deeper review. Use period format: 'FY2024' for annual, 'Q1-2024' for quarterly. Pass `period_a` as the EARLIER period and `period_b` as the LATER one — if you invert them the server auto-swaps and sets `swapped: true` in the response so deltas always carry the correct sign (rather than silently flipping). Pass `statement: "cash_flow"` to get the cash-flow lines instead (D&A, stock-based compensation, deferred taxes, other non-cash items, working-capital changes, operating/investing/financing cash flow, capex, buybacks, dividends): each carries its `fact_id`, `delta_derived_id`, a `not_reported` availability where the filer has no fact and a `sign_note` saying whether a positive figure is a use or a source of cash. For a cash-flow line quote `period_a_statement_display` / `period_b_statement_display` (the sign the statement prints: a use of cash is negative) and cite `period_a_statement_id` / `period_b_statement_id` (a `fact_id`, or a `derived_id` that `verify_facts` re-derives); `period_x_display` keeps the stored XBRL sign. Quote figures verbatim. Point-in-time safe via as_of_date. Available on all plans.

as_of_date.description: Point-in-time date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only returns facts with accepted_at on or before this date — eliminates look-ahead bias for backtesting.

period_a.description: Earlier fiscal period. Format: 'FY2023' for annual or 'Q1-2023' for quarterly.

period_b.description: Later fiscal period. Format: 'FY2024' for annual or 'Q1-2024' for quarterly.

statement.description: Omit for the 15 core metrics. 'cash_flow' returns the cash-flow statement lines instead; quote each line's `period_x_statement_display` with its `period_x_statement_id`; `sign_note` explains the stored sign.

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol, e.g. AAPL, MSFT, BRK.B — or a CIK (SEC identifier), e.g. '0000320193'.

name: compare_periods

_meta.description: Response metadata (provenance, point-in-time flag, freshness, request id and warnings). Every field is documented once in the agent contract (agent_contract.meta in the server's manifest.json).

changes.description: Per-metric deltas: metric, label, period_a, period_b, delta, delta_pct, significance

material_changes.description: Count of metrics flagged as a material change

period_a.description: Earlier period descriptor: label, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_end, filing_date

period_b.description: Later period descriptor, same shape as period_a

swapped.description: True when inputs were reordered so period_b is the more recent period

total_metrics.description: Count of metrics compared across the two periods

title: Compare Financial Periods
